title: the runner, turn after turn
line: the runner takes the queue's first person, runs their turn with the network standing in (a challenge at a connector is an error run and the turn goes on), names them again and passes them over once their turn held nothing new, runs the next person and stops with the turn's state kept when that turn pauses on pages to save, refusing a fresh run while it is paused; --resume picks the paused turn up, passes its person over the same way when nothing came back, goes on to the next person, and stops again when that turn pauses; resumed once more it stops after --turns; the run's state is cleared when it ends and a fresh run starts the count again

steps.say: the home person's parents confirmed on the owner's word, so the queue names the home person's own open question, then the grandparents

two turns: the first person's turn holds nothing new (a challenge at the first connector, an error run; nothing at the rest), and the queue names them again, so they are passed over; the next person's turn pauses on pages to save

expect.why: the home person's turn ran and held nothing new; named again, he is passed over; the grandfather's turn paused
the paused turn's own state is kept, as turn.py keeps it
the runner's state is kept beside the turn's, and the summary says what stopped it
the challenge is an error run: the source did not answer, the step stays runnable and the next turn asks it again

steps.say: a fresh run while a turn is paused is refused

resumed with nothing saved: the paused turn is finished and its person, named again with nothing new, is passed over; the next person's turn is the third and pauses on her own marriage-index page, so the run stops again with both states kept

expect.why: the resumed turn counts as the second; its person is passed over once named again; the grandmother is the third and pauses
the grandmother's paused turn keeps its own state
the run stops on the pause with its state kept, the summary saying so

steps.say: resumed again with nothing saved: the grandmother's turn is finished, the third turn is the last asked for, and the run's state is cleared

expect.why: the paused turn is resumed and its state cleared
the resumed turn is the third, finished with nothing new
the run ended on --turns: its state file is gone, the summary says so

steps.say: a fresh run starts the count again: the queue names the home person first as before, and nobody is passed over for the last run's reasons

expect.why: a new run: the home person's turn runs once more, nobody passed over yet
